C1451.title: Solidity Smart Contract Timestamp Dependence Vulnerability Analysis
C1451.summary: OWASP smart-contract security guidance identifies timestamp dependence as a common vulnerability. Ethereum contracts often use block.timestamp for auctions, lotteries, token vesting, and other time-sensitive logic, while block producers can adjust timestamps within protocol constraints. If developers use a timestamp as a randomness source or critical condition, a malicious producer may influence a drawing, end an auction early, or trigger an unfair gain.
